UserBatchCreate.description:
One create in POST /v1/users/batch. ``replace`` is the single route's
``?replace=1``: without it a create on a slot holding a named user is
refused.
UserBatchCreate.title: UserBatchCreate

UserBatchResponse.description:
Results in request order, and the freshness of the catalog read the
results come from (as in GET /v1/export/catalog).
UserBatchResponse.title: UserBatchResponse

UserBatchResult.description:
The outcome for one write of a batch. ``verified`` is False with a
``detail`` when the panel, read back after the write, does not hold what
was sent; ``user`` is None when the user is not there at all.
UserBatchResult.title: UserBatchResult

UserBatchUpdate.description: One update in POST /v1/users/batch: a PATCH of user ``id``.
UserBatchUpdate.title: UserBatchUpdate

post.description:
Several creates and updates in one panel configuration event.

Refused as a whole, with nothing written, when the batch is empty,
too long (JABLOTRON_PANEL_BATCH_MAX_RECORDS), names a slot twice, or
does not fit the write transport (400 batch_rejected); when a record
breaks a user-table rule against the panel's table and the batch's
other records (400 user_write_rejected with user_id); and on an
occupied slot without replace or an update of a missing user (409).
A record the panel holds differently after the write is
verified: false, not an error.
